name: Vintage horn-speaker revival with compression driver

mentions.name: Vintage horn-speaker revival with compression driver
mentions.description: This project revives a vintage horn speaker, replacing its long-dead Atwater Kent driver with a new compression driver after talkbox testing confirmed the horn's honky character.
mentions.problem: The original Atwater Kent driver in the vintage horn speaker was long since dead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just got a vintage horn-speaker. The actual Atwater Kent driver was long since dead, but I ordered a compression driver to feed it after testing it with a talkbox and finding it sounds amazingly honky!
